Oregon: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open Oregon on the map

Key dates

  • Voter registration deadline: October 13, 2026. Last day to register to vote or to change party affiliation for this election. Online registration is open until 11:59 p.m.
  • Ballots mailed to all registered voters: October 14, 2026 to October 20, 2026. Oregon votes by mail. Every registered voter gets a ballot automatically, so you do not need to request one. If yours has not arrived by October 30, call your county elections office. Oregon has no separate early voting period.
  • Recommended last day to mail your ballot: October 27, 2026. Election officials recommend mailing your ballot at least one week before Election Day. After that, use an official drop box or ask for a manual postmark at a post office.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Ballots must be in an official drop box by 8 p.m., or mailed with a USPS postmark dated by 8 p.m. on Election Day. County elections offices are open 7 a.m. to 8 p.m.

Official election information: vote.gov

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.
